relations.name: source_row
relations.meaning: A referent is grounded to an authoritative source row or document span.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple points to an exact file path and row, record key, or document locator in sources/.
relations.construction_rule: C0/C1: emit one tuple per compiled referent with SOURCE grounding to the originating observation.

relations.name: invoice_billed_name
relations.meaning: The billed_name field as represented on an invoice in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Exact billed_name string from invoices.json for the invoice referent.
relations.construction_rule: C1: parse invoices.json; invoice referent id invoice:<invoice_id>; billed_name copied verbatim.

relations.name: invoice_amount
relations.meaning: The billed amount as represented on an invoice in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Numeric amount field from invoices.json.
relations.construction_rule: C1: copy amount from each invoice record.

relations.name: invoice_currency
relations.meaning: The currency code as represented on an invoice in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Currency field from invoices.json.
relations.construction_rule: C1: copy currency from each invoice record.

relations.name: invoice_period
relations.meaning: The billing period as represented on an invoice in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Period field from invoices.json.
relations.construction_rule: C1: copy period from each invoice record.

relations.name: invoice_status
relations.meaning: The invoice payment status as represented in billing sources (e.g. open, paid).
relations.grounding_contract: Status field from invoices.json without reinterpretation.
relations.construction_rule: C1: copy status verbatim from each invoice record.

relations.name: crm_account_name
relations.meaning: The account_name field as represented for a CRM account.
relations.grounding_contract: account_name from crm.csv for crm:<crm_account_id> referent.
relations.construction_rule: C1: parse crm.csv; referent id crm:<crm_account_id>; copy account_name.

relations.name: registry_legal_name
relations.meaning: The registered legal_name as represented in the company registry.
relations.grounding_contract: legal_name from company_registry.csv for registry:<company_number> referent.
relations.construction_rule: C1: parse company_registry.csv; referent id registry:<company_number>; copy legal_name.

relations.name: registry_status
relations.meaning: The registry status as represented for a company (e.g. active, dissolved).
relations.grounding_contract: status field from company_registry.csv.
relations.construction_rule: C1: copy registry status verbatim.

relations.name: contract_counterparty_name
relations.meaning: The counterparty name as stated on a contract document.
relations.grounding_contract: Counterparty line from contract markdown for contract:<filename-without-.md> referent.
relations.construction_rule: C1: parse Counterparty field from each sources/contracts/*.md file.

relations.name: contract_document_kind
relations.meaning: The document kind as represented in contract heading or filename (e.g. msa, sow).
relations.grounding_contract: Heading or filename token from contract source without purpose policy.
relations.construction_rule: C1: classify each contract file as msa or sow from its title line or SOW filename prefix.

relations.name: contract_expiry_date
relations.meaning: An explicit expiry or end date stated on a contract document, when present.
relations.grounding_contract: Expiry/term-end date text span from contract markdown when explicitly stated.
relations.construction_rule: C1: extract stated expiry date from contract text; omit tuple when no explicit expiry is represented.

relations.name: contract_term_text
relations.meaning: The term or duration clause text as represented on a contract document.
relations.grounding_contract: Term section text from contract markdown.
relations.construction_rule: C1: copy the Term line or section verbatim from each contract file.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.meaning: Two referents denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet. SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not compatibility.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: for each candidate pair, ground disposition in authoritative source evidence; never infer from string similarity alone.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Emit directed pairs among crm:, billing:, registry:, and contract: identifier forms required to connect each commercially relevant CRM account, its billed name, governing contract, and registry candidate legal entity implied by sources and commercial_notes.md; include mechanical legal-form variant pairs only when names differ solely by exact legal-form normalization.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether two cross-system identifiers refer to the same legal counterparty.

relations.name: contract_clause_judgment
relations.meaning: A specific contractual clause kind is present in, absent from, or cannot be resolved from the contract text.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet citing contract text spans for PRESENT or ABSENT; ambiguous or silent passages yield UNRESOLVED.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: read contract markdown and judge each allowed kind independently from textual evidence.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per (contract referent, kind) where kind is drawn from the union of purpose_a.json and purpose_c.json allowed_kinds: change_of_control_consent, change_of_control_termination, assignment_notice_or_consent, assignment_consent, assignment_notice, assignment_competitor_prohibition, competitor_assignment_prohibition, exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the contract text establishes the named clause kind.

relations.name: invoice_open
relations.meaning: An invoice whose billing source status is open.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt over invoice_status with SOURCE/WORLD inputs.
relations.construction_rule: C4: SELECT invoice FROM invoice_status WHERE status = 'open'.

relations.name: contract_stated_expired
relations.meaning: A contract document that explicitly states it has expired or includes a past expiry date.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt from contract_expiry_date and explicit expired language in contract text.
relations.construction_rule: C4: contract has contract_expiry_date in the past or explicit expired/not-renewed language in sources (e.g. SOW-VEL-2022).

relations.name: diligence_active_contract
relations.meaning: A contract treated as active under diligence policy, excluding expired statements of work.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt referencing contract_document_kind and contract_stated_expired; policy excludes expired sow.
relations.construction_rule: C4 purpose policy: contract referents that are not (kind=sow AND contract_stated_expired); encodes purpose A/C active-contract rule.

relations.name: acquisition_relevant_contract
relations.meaning: An active diligence contract bearing at least one acquisition-relevant clause kind under purpose A policy.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt over diligence_active_contract and contract_clause_judgment filtered to purpose_a.json allowed_kinds with disposition PRESENT.
relations.construction_rule: C4 purpose A: diligence_active_contract joined to contract_clause_judgment where kind in purpose_a allowed_kinds and disposition is PRESENT.

relations.name: commercial_dependency_row
relations.meaning: A contract-counterparty pair that is a candidate dependency row under purpose C policy, including rows withheld when identity is unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt combining diligence_active_contract, contract_clause_judgment (C kinds PRESENT), invoice_open, and identity_judgment per purpose_c.json row_inclusion.
relations.construction_rule: C4 purpose C: emit (counterparty, contract) for each diligence_active_contract with a qualifying obligation kind; counterparty uses purpose B identifier forms; include rows where identity join is UNRESOLVED for output status unresolved.
